card.name: Just before a named drug in a list
card.fires_on: Words and word parts right before a specific drug name, such as 'methyl' before xanthines or prednisolone, or 'including' and 'notably' before an example drug. It fires in lists of drug classes and examples.

modes.label: Methyl before drug name
modes.description: The word 'methyl' sits just before the rest of a drug name such as xanthines, prednisolone or salicylate.

modes.description: A linking word or comma comes right before the named examples of a drug class or substance.
